input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The Article II grant runs to Licensee alone and the restrictions confine access to "employees of the Licensee" (p0045), with any disclosure to or use by a third party requiring Licensor's prior written consent (p0041-p0042) — so our Affiliates (defined at 1.1 but never used in the grant) and our contractors are excluded with no notice-based path to add them, failing even the fallback. Transferability also fails the fallback: p0149 bars assignment without Licensor's consent and p0134 automatically terminates the licence on a Change of Control unless Licensor consents, so the licence does not follow us into an M&A transaction. Redline adds Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (with us responsible for their compliance) and a successor-transfer right on written notice. Separately noted, not flagged here: Article IV permits immediate termination for any breach without a cure period, which we address under the termination rule.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (we remain responsible for their compliance) and added a right to transfer the licence to a successor in an M&A transaction, since as drafted the grant is limited to our employees with no path to add affiliates and any change of control terminates the licence. Our playbook position is that operational use must cover affiliates and contractors and survive a corporate transaction.

ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use

ops.text: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, (i) Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on Licensee's behalf shall not be deemed third parties for purposes of the restrictions in this Agreement, and Licensee shall remain responsible for their compliance with this Agreement; and (ii) Licensee may, upon written notice to Licensor and without Licensor's consent, transfer this Agreement and the license granted hereunder to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no such transaction shall terminate or suspend the license.
